dataset.name: Marine Engine Fault
dataset.acquisition: controlled marine-diesel test bench with physically induced fault/anomaly scenarios

files.csv_count_semantics: Confirmed by the successful exact-head Rust archive audit: 16 recording data CSVs (one baseline plus fifteen fault-scenario files) plus two separate metadata CSV exports (dataset_index and variable_dictionary). The archive contains 18 CSV entries total.

labels.limitation: The two injection-nozzle scenario files contain anomalous operation only; they do not contain pre-anomaly samples and cannot support onset-latency evaluation without an independent injection-time source.

missingness.representation: empty fields; retain missingness, never impute zero or nominal

file.name: Marine_Engine_Fault_Data_v1.zip
file.sha256_receipt_status: verified by successful exact-head raw CSV audit run 43312150806, with machine-readable artifact 13986307496

publication.title: Marine Engine Fault Dataset: Open-Access Data under Controlled Reference and Fault Scenario Conditions
publication.evidence_review_status: abstract reviewed; full manuscript and raw dataset archive not independently audited

non_interchangeability.with_liu_ice: Do not concatenate records, merge class IDs, or claim an apples-to-apples leaderboard. LiU-ICE has different fault semantics, channel identities, sample/interface contract and model; the Marine Engine Fault record has a separate three-row header and 70/73-column schemas.
non_interchangeability.engine_identity: This dataset metadata identifies a MU323DGSC test-bench engine. It does not establish independent multi-engine or fleet validation. The physical engine identity/campaign identity must be audited from the README and file index.
non_interchangeability.signal_mapping: Only map channels after inspecting the variable dictionary, units, measurement provenance, calibration and derived-variable parentage. Same shorthand or similar names alone are insufficient.
non_interchangeability.fault_mapping: Map to a common component/function ontology only after engineering review. Similar subsystem labels do not prove identical fault mechanisms, magnitude or sensor observability.

evaluation_tracks.required: Completed by exact-head GitHub Actions run 43311807638: publisher size and MD5 verified, archive SHA-256 recorded, 16 recording CSVs separated from two metadata CSV exports, all CSVs parsed under role-specific 70/73-column schemas, time fields verified in seconds and strictly increasing, and index/dictionary/normalization-script hashes present in the machine-readable receipt.
evaluation_tracks.qualification: Archive and CSV payload semantics are audited. Model evaluation, label-to-physical-cause validity, physical run identities, held-out splits, and external validation remain not executed.

evaluation_tracks.split: Whole-file recording holdout; reserve complete load-level recordings as test where each fault family has sufficient file-level support.
controls: no normalization statistics from held-out files
load labels used only if available at prediction time
report the count of distinct files per fault/load

evaluation_tracks.split: Exclude all files for one fault family from training, feature selection and calibration; treat that family as unknown at inference.
evaluation_tracks.limitation: With only a small number of files per class this is exploratory and does not establish general rejection of genuinely novel mechanisms.

evaluation_tracks.protocol: Use the five runs with blank channel fields as naturally missing-channel cases; keep missing values explicit and audit whether missingness correlates with a scenario or file.
evaluation_tracks.limitation: Do not synthesize a physical sensor failure claim from blank export cells.

evaluation_tracks.eligible_records: Only scenario files with documented pre-anomaly samples and independently auditable onset/offset timestamps.
evaluation_tracks.excluded_records: The two injection-nozzle files with anomaly-only operation cannot establish onset latency unless an independent injection log supplies onset.

evaluation_tracks.protocol: Train/evaluate separately on LiU-ICE and Marine Engine Fault; add a common semantic signal map and component/function ontology only where the variable dictionaries support it. Report zero-shot transfer, frozen-model transfer and limited labelled adaptation as three distinct tracks.
evaluation_tracks.limitation: No direct class mapping or sample-level pooled score. A matching engine model name does not create independent engine transfer or label equivalence.

research_targets_not_achieved.target: At matched false-alarm exposure, improve worst-held-out-load event recall by at least 5 percentage points over the best reproduced baseline, with recording-level uncertainty.
No more than 5% false-known assignments on held-out fault-family files, without collapsing known-fault macro recall.
No hidden imputation, and no more than 2 percentage points degradation in supported-stratum event recall under naturally missing channels, or explicit abstention.
P95 confirmation latency at or below 5 seconds on records with authoritative onset timestamps, at no greater false-alarm rate than the matched baseline.
Demonstrate positive transfer or quantify negative transfer across the separate LiU-ICE and Marine Engine Fault tracks using reviewed semantic mappings and no pooled-label shortcut.

claim_ceiling: The ZIP was downloaded by the exact-head GitHub Actions runner and its publisher-reported size and MD5 matched; a SHA-256 was computed but its value is not yet committed in the receipt. Extracted file inventory, CSV payload, physical run identities, per-file missingness, splits and model results remain unaudited; no model accuracy or cross-engine/fleet claim is made.

source_interpretation.reported_intervention_label: The five class names describe the experimental anomaly scenarios reported by the dataset creators.
source_interpretation.causal_limit: A scenario label is not by itself proof that the intervention reproduces the full causal physics, degradation progression or failure envelope of an in-service fault.
source_interpretation.audit_requirement: Review the archive README, intervention procedures, channel dictionary and manuscript before interpreting a scenario label as a physical root cause or using it to claim field representativeness.
source_interpretation.secondary_review_note: A secondary review of the data descriptor flags potential proxy interventions and qualitative technical validation. Treat this as an audit lead, not an authoritative correction to the dataset creators' metadata.
